lemma allB {b:ℝ}(hP:Tendsto (fun n=> bonusB (P n)) atTop (𝓝 b)) : ∃ f X g,Banked Y P Q f X g :=by
    obtain ⟨r,hr,f,X',g',hX⟩:= awaiting Y h he hp hU P Q; refine ⟨f, bankA Y h he hp hU P Q (fun i=>Stationary.Artes.travels (fun t ht=>?_))⟩
    obtain ⟨s,hs,k,W,g,h'⟩:= awaiting Y h he hp (hU.comp ht.tendsto_atTop) (fun i=>P (t i)) (fun i=>Q (t i))
    let P':=fun i=> P (t (s i)); have hv:= ht.comp hs; have hf := (accord h he hp (hU.comp hv.tendsto_atTop) (hU.comp hr.tendsto_atTop) (u:=fun i=> u (t (s i))) (P:=P') h' hX ⟨_,hP.comp hv.tendsto_atTop,hP.comp hr.tendsto_atTop⟩ i).1
    exact ⟨s,hs,hf ▸ (h'.angles i)⟩

proof_context.conclusion: `allB` shows that, for convergent endpoints `bonusB (P n) → b`, the scalars, activity coordinates and corrections converge along the full sequence, because every subsequence has a further subsequence with the limits fixed by `accord`.

lemma palm (m:ℕ): Tendsto (fun i=>draws (P i) m) atTop (𝓝 (fromLambda (Ω m) (f m))):=by
    have hx:Continuous (fromLambda (Ω m)):=by unfold fromLambda; fun_prop
    exact (hx.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (h.angles m)).congr' ((he.eventually_ge_atTop m).mono fun i hi=>spoken Y (P i) m hi)

proof_context.conclusion: `palm` shows that `draws (P i) m` (the coupling β_m) converges to `fromLambda (Ω m) (f m)`, by continuity of `fromLambda`.

paths (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ (s : PathData G) (v : ℝ), s.Bounds (R.alloy.B.a.params m).clip (R.alloy.B.a.params m).width
        (R.alloy.B.a.params m).paths (R.alloy.B.a.clock.loopCap m) ∧
      (R.alloy.B.a.params m).width < v ∧
      ∀ g > 0, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, Stationary.Artes.Rios (p := R.alloy.B.kin.path n m) (q := s) v g

proof_context.conclusion: The field `paths` of `Winter` gives the path convergence at a width `v` strictly larger than the chart width.

convergence (p : ℕ) (Z : ∀ N, Contest N p T.L) (b : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun i => (Z i).bonusB) atTop (𝓝 b) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ u v,
      Tendsto (fun N => (Z N |>.trail m).beta) atTop (𝓝 u) ∧
      Tendsto (fun N => Window.coats T.gains (halls T p N) (Z N) m) atTop (𝓝 v)

proof_context.conclusion: The field `convergence`, proved in `Campaign.offers` from `allB` and `palm`, gives full-sequence convergence of the couplings and activity coordinates at every fixed level for convergent endpoint sequences.
